caption: The video captures a close-up, eye-level view of a single transparent ice sphere resting on a bed of sparkling, granular snow. Throughout, the sphere holds its position, size, and orientation, neither translating, rotating, deforming, nor visibly melting. Inside the clear globe, feathery white frost crystals spread in delicate patterns, while a small patch of iridescent cyan-to-pink coloration glows near the top. The surrounding snow surface stays fixed and glittering, and the camera holds steady without any pan, tilt, or zoom. Behind the sphere, a dark, out-of-focus porch railing and a couple of chairs form a shadowy backdrop. Nothing new appears, and no contact or motion event disturbs the scene. The result is a sustained, static observation of the frozen sphere settled in the snow.
relations: The transparent ice sphere rests on granular snow, maintaining its position, size, and orientation without melting or deforming.
Feathery frost crystals and an iridescent cyan-to-pink glow persist steadily within the clear globe.
The sparkling snow surface and shadowy porch backdrop remain fixed under a steady, eye-level camera view.
